snippet.title: Konran:Zanki OG 2021 - TRAILER
snippet.description:
Konran:Zanki is a sci-fi, mystery visual novel developed by Fujitsuki (previously known as Polar Moon) using the RPG Maker VX ace engine.

◾️SYNOPSIS :

Fujita Anju finds herself trapped in an unfamiliar location with several other people.
As their memory loss, as well as the ominous situation, seems to indicate that 
something wrong is going on, a weird cubic creature named Dokuroku appears 
with the intention to hack into their Prisms, a daily-use microchip
implanted in the body at birth, in order to intrude their memories and retrieve a key element that has been lost in a foggy past. 


 🌙 Soundtrack by : Dumperghost
🌙 Montage by : WistieCutie
🌙 Artwork by : WistieCutie


.Download the game here : https://fujitsuki.itch.io/konranzanki

.Discord server : https://discord.gg/kETYDpw

✨Don’t forget to gaze at the celestial skies and admire the serene Wisteria Moon.🌙
